slots.title: France–Germany bond gap tops 140 basis points
slots.body:

slots.title: Refresco IPO talks at $10B-plus
slots.body:
Refresco, one of the world’s largest independent beverage manufacturers, is weighing a potential U.S. listing.

Reuters says the company and KKR have taken pitches from investment banks in recent weeks for roles on an IPO.

The report cites people familiar with the matter and mentions a $10 billion-plus valuation figure — not a finalized price or timetable.

An offering would mark how public markets size contract manufacturing and private-label drinks demand.

No date or share count appears in the report; the next step is whether banks are formally hired.

slots.title: Lycia Therapeutics files U.S. IPO
slots.body:
Lycia Therapeutics ($LYCA) is in the market with a U.S. IPO for its autoimmune and inflammatory pipeline.

Seeking Alpha notes the company is clinical-stage, with lead candidate LCA-0061 in Phase 1 for food allergy — the piece describes IgE reduction in early trials.

Proceeds are framed for advancing multiple programs, including Graves’ disease work.

The syndicate and management track record are part of the filing story; terms and pricing are not set until the book builds.

Food allergy is a growing treatment category; the filing is the public checkpoint on trial funding and timeline.
